purpose: High-level evidence datasets that require specialist filtering or aggregation while remaining first-class World Map controls. Canonical records stay in their source datasets; this manifest owns discovery/loading metadata only.
rules: Evidence layers never become generic character or risk scores.
Source classifications remain attributed to their source organization.
Snapshot vintage and methodology must be visible.
Evidence controls live in the visible World Bar, not only legacy hidden menus.
Subnational evidence reuses canonical subdivision geometry where possible.
